Product photograph of one pair of boots on a seamless pure white background, as on a shoe store product page, wide 3:2 frame with generous margins, both boots fully visible and sharp at the same scale. Left boot: strict side profile, outer side, toe pointing left, so the Swoosh reads clearly. Right boot: three-quarter front view, slightly behind and to the right, without overlapping the first. E-commerce studio light, gentle contact shadows, tack sharp, real textile, leather, laces and rubber detail, never CGI.
The boots are exactly the boots the man wears in IMAGE 1: black waterproof Nike ACG winter boots with a padded collar, black laces, a chunky lug rubber sole and a small Swoosh on the outer side, correctly shaped. No other brand, no other text.
IMAGE 2 is only the reference for the composition and light of the shoe photos of this series. Copy nothing else from it.
No person, no feet, no props, no watermark.
